name: Rapid Cycle turns Lunar Phase stacks into 4% ranged haste each (#1527)
contract: Rapid Cycle 300249 (Spell.dbc, family 32) carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2), EffectBasePoints 3 with DieSides 1 (+4) and EffectSpellClassMask word1 0x1, which is Lunar Phase 802985's SpellFamilyFlags word1. 802985 effect index 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_RANGED_HASTE (140) with EffectBasePoints 0 and DieSides 0, a base of 0, so the modifier is the only source of the tooltip's 'increases your ranged haste by 4% per stack'; aura amounts are multiplied by the stack count. AscensionStarcallerContracts.cpp used to call dummy(1) on 802985, which turned that effect into SPELL_AURA_DUMMY, so HandleAuraModRangedHaste never ran whatever the talent did. The assertion reads the native result, the hasted ranged swing time in UNIT_FIELD_RANGEDATTACKTIME (attack_time_ms hand 2): Player::InitStatsForLevel (Player.cpp:2762) leaves it at the 2000 ms base without a ranged weapon and Unit::ApplyAttackTimePercentMod divides it by (100+amount)/100, so four stacks at 4% give 2000/1.16 = 0.862 of the control's value. Both fixtures are the same race, class and level, receive 802985 by set_aura at 4 stacks (its StackAmount after the contract), and the talent is learned before the aura so the modifier is in place when the aura amount is calculated. aura_amount is not asserted because a dummy effect keeps the same amount and would not fail before the fix. The control must stay at ratio 1.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Learn Rapid Cycle before the aura exists
Ranged swing time without Lunar Phase
Ranged swing time of the talent fixture without Lunar Phase
Four Lunar Phase stacks on the control
Four Lunar Phase stacks on the talent fixture
Control keeps the base ranged swing time
Four stacks of Rapid Cycle give 16% ranged haste
